composed_json_note: composed.json is NOT committed (uniform-1.0 witnesses make it tens of MB to multi-GB even for short sequences). Regenerate locally with GAMMA_WHISPER_FARKAS_EMIT_COMPOSED=1.
prefix_note: Whisper-tiny's full sequential PropNetwork is not end-to-end IBP-tractable (positional-encoding AddConstant expects a fixed sequence length; attention softmax blows up at any epsilon). The fixture uses the longest finite-bounds prefix, partitioned into NUM_BLOCKS Farkas blocks. This is sufficient for Phase 2's 'valid composition pipeline demo'; future phases should verify the remaining attention-heavy layers via graph-mode CROWN.
soundness_note: Uniform 1.0 Farkas multipliers are pipeline-validation-only and carry NO information about the network. See gamma-propagate proof_certificate/constructive/clean_flat_export.rs soundness caveat.
